portal_hypertension.title: Immune-checkpoint inhibitors for advanced hepatocellular carcinoma in Child-Turcotte-Pugh-B cirrhosis: a liver-centric approach to outcomes beyond tumor progression.
portal_hypertension.authors: Agrawal D, Jothimani D, Bhoori S
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究。核心观点：免疫检查点抑制剂 (ICIs) 彻底改变了 Child-Turcotte-Pugh A (CTP-A) 肝硬化晚期肝细胞癌 (HCC) 的结局。 临床提示：然而，现实世界中 30-40% 的晚期 HCC 病例涉及 CTP-B 肝硬化，但被排除在关键试验之外，这代表着大量未满足的需求。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) have revolutionized advanced hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) outcomes in Child-Turcotte-Pugh A (CTP-A) cirrhosis. However, 30-40% of real-world advanced HCC cases involve CTP-B cirrhosis, yet are excluded from pivotal trials, representing a substantial unmet need. Immunotherapy for CTP-B HCC has not yet been comprehensively reviewed. This narrative review summarizes the latest evidence on ICIs in CTP-B HCC through January 2026, evaluating ICI efficacy, safety, and patient selection algorithms across CTP-B subclasses. portal_hypertension.title: Lumped parameter modeling of changes in liver hemodynamics due to cirrhosis.
portal_hypertension.authors: Joseph EL, Saini H, Kini U
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：这项数值研究采用人体肝脏血流的计算模型来研究肝硬化的血流动力学后果。 临床提示：肝脏通过双入口系统（门静脉和肝动脉）接收血液，该系统灌注复杂的血窦网络；然而，肝硬化引起的纤维化扭曲了这些通道，增加了液压阻力
portal_hypertension.abstract: This numerical study employs a computational model of human hepatic blood flow to investigate the hemodynamic consequences of cirrhosis. The liver receives blood through a dual-inlet system (portal vein and hepatic artery) that perfuses a complex network of sinusoids; however, cirrhosis-induced fibrosis distorts these channels, increasing hydraulic resistance. In turn, portal pressure is elevated, leading to the potential recanalization of portosystemic collaterals.
